android.desc:
BUSY — Focus Timer & Distraction Blocker

Stay focused. Get more done.
BUSY helps you block distractions and stay on track. Whether you need short breaks or deep focus sessions, BUSY works for you — on your phone and your Wear OS smartwatch.

Key Features:
- Start a BUSY Session. Use a simple timer, set up your own Pomodoro-style workflow, or dive in with no time limit.
- BUSY Bar Сontrol. Connect and manage your BUSY Bar from your phone. Start focus sessions, block distractions, update firmware, connect to Wi-Fi, and more.
- Music Themes. Customize your focus with sleek, modern designs ands sounds that match your vibe.
- Block Distractions. Automatically block distracting apps, mute notifications, and stay in control.
- No “5 More Minutes”. Stay accountable with sessions you can’t skip.
- Track Your Attempts. See how often you try to open blocked apps — and improve over time.
- Wear OS Support. Start, stop, or skip your focus timer directly from your Wear OS watch. Everything syncs instantly with your phone.

BUSY is designed to help you focus better, block distractions, and get things done — wherever you are.
